svg.aria-label: Five paired bars, before and after the unsupervised cycle that wrote v3 from v2. Four gold-free signals computed on the same 47-task probe of the 450 all improved: method consistency 0.43 to 0.69, pass agreement 0.66 to 0.89, invariants passed 17 of 21 to 21 of 21, format compliance 0.97 to 1.00, and errors fell from 3 to 0. The fifth pair is the gold anchor: the ten dev tasks fell from 9 to 7 passed, tasks 49 and 1681 broke, and gate A held v3. Gold-free signals agreed the agent was better; the gold said two tasks were now wrong.
svg.title: Every gold-free signal improved, and the ten gold tasks still held v3
